name: Legacy external storage
plain: Old permission for reading and writing shared files.
meaning: Opened all shared files to any app that asked. Replaced by scoped storage and granular media permissions.

android.revocation: Settings > Apps > Permissions > Files and media
android.note: Effectively ineffective on Android 11+ (API 30) for apps targeting 11; READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE ignored for media on 13.

ios.note: iOS apps have always been sandboxed.

limits.headline: Can't open shared files with the old storage permission on newer Android, and never on iPhone
limits.user_action: You tap Allow on a storage prompt, which no longer does much
can: Ask for the old storage permission on older Android
Open shared files freely on Android 10 and older
Still show the prompt on some apps, with little effect
cannot: Open shared files on Android 11 and newer when the app targets that version
Open photos or videos on Android 13 with the old permission; it is ignored for media
Exist on iPhone; apps have always been sandboxed
limits.differs: Android only. The old permission worked before Android 11 and is mostly ignored now. iPhone never had it.

story.what_it_is: An old Android permission that opened your shared files to any app that asked.
story.for_you: Years ago, a pop up asked to access photos, media and files, and a yes opened almost everything. Newer Android replaced it with narrower choices, so you rarely see it now.
story.for_makers: It made file handling easy for makers but gave them too much. Google replaced it with scoped storage and granular media permissions, and Play blocks it for new apps.

use_cases.example: An old music app used it to scan every folder for songs.
An old game saved data to a shared folder so you could back it up by hand.
An old cleaner app deleted junk files across all folders.
An old photo editor saved edits to shared pictures.
Old malware used it to read other apps' downloaded files.

risks: Old apps may still use it
story.android_note: Replaced by scoped storage and granular media permissions, and no longer effective on new versions.
story.ios_note: iPhone never had this kind of access.

technical_bounds: Scoped storage limits app to its own files and media it creates
